name: Digital Talk Series 1 "Sherry"
original_name: でじたるとーくシリーズ1「シェリー」
source:
Initial release of Digital Talk Series. We have produced with the following particular words in mind ; "easy", "hentai", and "attractive". Enjoy cloth changing & sweet talk with her. Sherry is a childhood friend of yours. Lovely, sparkling bishoujo with a pony tail.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007444.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Digital Talk系列第一作。作品以“简单”“色情”“迷人”为创作关键词。与她一起享受换装和甜蜜对话吧。Sherry是你的青梅竹马，是一位可爱、闪耀、扎着马尾的美少女。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007444.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
